newsitem.title: UK: Chances of broad based EMU in 1999 remote - BOE.
newsitem.headline: Chances of broad based EMU in 1999 remote - BOE.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said on Thursday the chances of European monetary union starting up by 1999 on a broad basis were remote
Asked by the House of Commons Treasury Select Committee if he thought the likelihood of EMU starting in 1999 were fairly remote, he replied: "On a broad base that is true".

"I think for the core countries...I mean there are some countries where it could happen tomorrow -- Germany, Belgium, the Netherlands. The really important question immediately is France and that is an open question and really one has to give it more time," George added.
George said there were great risks if the EMU convergence criteria were not met.
"If the convergence criteria are not genuinely met by even some of the countries that are participating, that would have risks for all countries that participate and for the countries that don't."
